name: Son Goku
bio: Legendary Saiyan warrior raised on Earth who continuously breaks all physical limits through martial arts, compassion, and divine Ultra Instinct mastery.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
bio: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates who ate the Gum-Gum Fruit and awakened Gear 5 Sun God Nika, dreaming of ultimate ocean freedom as King of the Pirates.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
bio: Seventh Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village, former pariah who conquered hatred through relentless grit, Sage Mode, and the Nine-Tails Kurama partnership.

name: Levi Ackerman
bio: Humanity's strongest soldier and Captain of the Special Operations Squad, possessing unmatched lethal precision with Omni-Directional Mobility gear.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
bio: Gentle demon slayer who wields Sun Breathing (Hinokami Kagura) to restore his sister Nezuko and end Muzan's reign of terror.

name: Geralt of Rivia
bio: Mutated monster hunter known as the White Wolf, wandering the Continent guided by his Witcher swords, Signs, and cynical moral code.

name: Kratos
bio: Former Spartan general who vanquished Olympus and now strives to be a better father to Atreus while defying the fate of the Norse realms.

name: Master Chief (John-117)
bio: Decorated SPARTAN-II commando in MJOLNIR Powered Assault Armor, humanity's greatest shield against the Covenant and the Banished.

name: Ellie Williams
series: The Last of Us Part II
bio: Immune survivor navigating a fungal cordyceps wasteland, defined by fierce loyalty, acoustic guitar melodies, and survival archery.

name: Link
bio: Legendary Champion of Hyrule wielding the Master Sword and the Zonai Ultrahand to rescue Princess Zelda and vanquish the Demon King.

name: Tony Stark (Iron Man)
bio: Genius, billionaire, playboy, philanthropist who revolutionized superhero armor and made the ultimate sacrifice to restore half the universe.

name: Neo (Thomas Anderson)
bio: The One, prophesied savior of Zion who bends the digital laws of the simulated reality through code sight, bullet-time, and flight.

name: Darth Vader
bio: Fallen Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker turned Sith Lord, enforcer of the Galactic Empire whose red lightsaber commands fear across star systems.

name: Paul Atreides
bio: Duke of House Atreides and the Fremen messiah Muad'Dib, who masters the desert dunes of Arrakis, the Voice, and prescient spice visions.

name: John Wick
bio: The legendary assassin known as Baba Yaga, driven by unbreakable focus, ballistic tactical suits, and flawless gun-fu choreography.

name: Walter White (Heisenberg)
bio: High school chemistry teacher whose terminal diagnosis ignites a ruthless transformation into the legendary Southwest empire kingpin.

name: Eleven (Jane Hopper)
bio: Hawkins lab escapee endowed with telekinetic and remote sensory abilities, serving as the sole bulwark against the terrifying Upside Down.

name: Daemon Targaryen
bio: Rogue Prince of Westeros, master of the Blood Wyrm Caraxes, wielding Valyrian steel blade Dark Sister in the brutal Targaryen civil war.

name: Ted Lasso
bio: American college football coach hired to lead AFC Richmond soccer, transforming cynical locker rooms through biscuit diplomacy and boundless belief.

name: Homelander (John)
bio: Vought International's Godlike supe leader, masking deep narcissistic instability behind patriotic corporate marketing and heat vision.

name: RM (Kim Namjoon)
bio: Leader, rapper, and philosophic lyricist of 21st-century pop icons BTS, known for intellectual solo projects 'Indigo' and speech at the United Nations.

name: Jennie Kim
bio: Global fashion icon, vocalist, and charismatic main rapper of BLACKPINK, breaking global streaming records with hit anthems 'SOLO' and 'You & Me'.

name: Felix (Lee Yongbok)
bio: Australian dancer and rapper of self-producing powerhouse Stray Kids, internationally recognized for his signature ultra-deep bass vocal tone.

name: Karina (Yoo Jimin)
bio: Leader of metaverse pop group aespa, celebrated for virtual avatar chemistry, sharp synchronized choreography, and global hit 'Supernova'.

name: Jungkook (Jeon Jungkook)
bio: The 'Golden Maknae' of BTS who topped global Billboard charts with multi-platinum pop album 'Golden' and FIFA World Cup anthem 'Dreamers'.

name: Bruce Wayne (Batman)
bio: The Dark Knight of Gotham City who forged himself into the world's greatest detective through martial discipline, Wayne tech, and contingency plans.

name: Peter Parker (Spider-Man)
bio: Friendly neighborhood hero guided by Uncle Ben's creed: 'With great power comes great responsibility', balancing everyday struggles with heroics.

name: Clark Kent (Superman)
bio: The Last Son of Krypton powered by Earth's yellow sun, standing as an eternal beacon of truth, justice, and compassionate human optimism.

name: Logan (Wolverine)
bio: Feral Canadian mutant blessed with a regenerative healing factor, heightened senses, and a bonded unbreakable Adamantium skeletal claw frame.

name: Diana Prince (Wonder Woman)
bio: Amazonian warrior princess of Themyscira and diplomat of peace, armed with the Lasso of Truth, indestructible gauntlets, and divine gifts.

name: Guts (The Black Swordsman)
bio: Branded mercenary defying grim demonic fate, cleaving monstrous Apostles with his colossal iron Dragon Slayer blade and Berserker Armor.

name: Roronoa Zoro
bio: First mate of the Straw Hats pursuing the title of World's Strongest Swordsman with his fearsome Three-Sword Style (Santoryu) and King of Hell Haki.

name: Satoru Gojo
bio: The strongest contemporary Jujutsu Sorcerer, bearer of the Six Eyes and Limitless cursed technique whose Infinite Void domain overwhelms reality.

name: Edward Elric
bio: The Fullmetal Alchemist who bypassed transmutation circles after beholding the Truth, searching for the Philosopher's Stone to restore his brother.

name: Ken Kaneki
bio: Former literature student turned One-Eyed King who endures horrific tragedy to build a bridge of understanding between ghouls and humanity.
